title: kith-chat/tests: test blob store uniqueness uses subsec_nanos, should use tempfile::TempDir
description: message.rs:986-999: make_blob_store() uses subsec_nanos() as the subdirectory name for test uniqueness. Multiple parallel tests running in the same second can collide. tempfile::TempDir provides OS-guaranteed unique names and automatic cleanup. Fix: use tempfile::TempDir::new() and return the guard alongside the store.
